name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
description: A frog spirit with an insatiable appetite, kept in check by Muldrotha and fused with Multani during the Phyrexian attack.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Yargle eats enough Phyrexian oil to clean up most of Urborg.
timeline.quote: But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.

citation.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Belzenlok transforms the ambitious Yar-Kul into a maggot.
timeline.quote: the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot.

citation.text: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha calls on Multani to fuse with Yargle to defend Urborg against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: it was Muldrotha who called upon her father, Multani, to fuse with Yargle and aid in its defense of Urborg.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: A spirit risen from a frog that ate the maggot Yar-Kul, who ate enough oil to clean up most of Urborg.

citation.text: Multiverse Legends: card flavor text (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
